sku.name: H100 SXM5 80GB HBM3
sku.note: sec 6.3 E5 登錄內容: 若實際機器不同(SKU/時脈/CUDA build)⇒預測無效,須重登錄而非事後放寬

l4_reference.name: NVIDIA L4
l4_reference.note: the L4 device the three input measurements below were taken on

scale_ratios.basis: count_freeze_30m.json's {base_n_nodes, total_n_nets, total_n_pins} (27.7M, T7b-frozen actual counts incl. glue) divided by probe_gp_memory's {num_physical, num_nets, num_pins} (11.31M mempool_cluster) -- same netlist family, same-GPU size extrapolation only (no H100 assumption here, see PHASE_S_BAND for that)

read.s_p_basis: s_p=1.0: CPU-only single-threaded parser, unaffected by GPU generation

gp.s_p_basis: s_p in [2.5, 5.0]: memory-bandwidth-ratio / FP32-throughput-ratio band (A100/H100 vs L4, common range) -- 未驗證假設, task instructions

lg.s_p_basis: s_p=1.0: legalization is mostly CPU + small kernels

eval.s_p_basis: s_p in [2.5, 5.0]: same band as gp (lattice walk + scatter, memory-bandwidth/FP32-throughput-bound) -- 未驗證假設, task instructions

wall_time_forecast.interval_type: hardware-assumption sensitivity band (NOT a statistical prediction interval -- design draft sec 6.3 E5(ii): "首跑不產生 prediction interval")

gpu_memory_forecast.lower_bound_basis: scaled peak_alloc_gb of the dominant component (eval) -- an analytic resident-tensor account substitute (design draft sec 6.3 E5(i)'s resident_tensors term), not a full per-tensor dtype x shape rebuild
gpu_memory_forecast.cuda_context_basis: L4-measured device_baseline_gb used as a placeholder for the (unmeasured) H100 constant -- T14's first run should replace this
gpu_memory_forecast.formula: design draft sec 6.3 E5(i): upper_bound = lower_bound + max_p transient_p + allocator_reserve + cuda_context (解析上下界,不是統計區間)

host_rss_forecast.model_status: unfit: design draft sec 1.1's 3-coefficient PlaceDB.read host RSS model (N_nodes/N_raw_pins fitting set) has not been fit yet -- results/m4/scaling/count_freeze_small.json's host_rss_three_coefficient_model.status == "pending_t0b"
host_rss_forecast.count_scale_basis: node_ratio (proxy only -- the eventual model also depends on N_raw_pins, not represented here)
host_rss_forecast.note: design draft sec 6.3 E5(iii): "僅在 §1.1 的模型通過辨識門檻時給 95% PI;否則只給解析估計與其假設" -- this is the "否則" branch: point estimate only, no prediction interval.

t14_check_protocol: design draft sec 6.3 E5 (T14 首跑的判定): 檢定假設,不是檢定區間 -- 逐 phase 比較實測 T_H100,p 與 T_L4,p/s_p,報出每個 phase 的實際 s_p^obs;主線假設被判為成立僅當每個 phase 的 s_p^obs 與宣告值同序(相對誤差 <= 50%)且總時間落在本檔wall_time_forecast 的 [total_fast_s, total_slow_s] 之間。記憶體則直接比對是否落在 gpu_memory_forecast 的 [lower_bound_gb, upper_bound_gb] 解析界內。首跑不產生新的 prediction interval。
refit_on_miss_note: design draft T14 row: 任一落外 ⇒ 在報告發表重擬合模型與歸因,不得事後放寬區間。(see scripts/m4_check_prediction.py)
